verdict.rationale: A five-year customer testimonial mentions 'dozens of purpose-named accounts with auto-funding rules' (mercury-comm-1), suggesting some auto top-up capability exists, but there is no first-party documentation describing this feature, its configuration, or thresholds, and no evidence at all of low-balance alerting functionality. Missing for 10: official docs on auto top-up/sweep rules between accounts, explicit low-balance alert/notification feature, and any first-party confirmation beyond a single anecdotal community mention.
